shots.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-frame environment keyframe for an actual playable 3D platformer cave boulder chase. Premium Crash Bandicoot 4 sculpted clay/hand-painted environment art, cinematic 1980s Goonies and Indiana Jones subterranean adventure. Match the Merchant Wreck cave family: large designed lavender-slate and indigo rock planes with softly bevelled edges, muted warm-grey facets, faint damp green-blue mineral stains, restrained moss and aged dark oak/brass. Clearly authored solid 3D geometry and original painted surfaces, rich but quiet material detail. No procedural noise, no tiled textures, no flat cardboard walls. Landscape 16:9, highest available resolution and fine detail, strong composed foreground/middle/background, readable playable route and physical supports. Lighting ONLY from real roof fissures, reflected light and subtle eerie mineral/bioluminescent glow. Absolutely no torches, fire, braziers, candles or lanterns. No text, logos or UI. A giant genuinely spherical cracked boulder is the pursuit threat; all rock walls are rooted and ceilings are present. The camera is ahead of the escaping player and looks back up the route. Do not show a helicopter view, giant empty arena or a maze diagram. This must be a believable reachable player camera composition. Opening release chamber: the foreground is a broad worn rock runway with a slight downhill fall toward camera and a low irregular outside edge, framed by close dark curving cave masses. At middle distance a perfectly round huge stone rolls out of a thick oval rock throat; a visible ancient pressure-seal ring and broken ship timbers explain its release. A high narrow roof fissure sends a dramatic diagonal cool-white daylight shaft across the round boulder and part of the pathway. A few small dim bioluminescent patches at the wall bases provide a secondary dim glow. The background bends into a second shadowed passage, revealing depth, with full rock overhead and an asymmetrical skylight rim. Strong hierarchy: bright upper-left opening and hero round boulder, warm desaturated runner lane in the lower centre, indigo side shadows. One tiny original skeleton adventurer may establish scale near the lower third. Exciting, beautiful, tactile, film-quality lighting, feasible game composition. Strict art direction: DARK GOONIES TUNNELS, claustrophobic and wet, low sculpted rock ceilings with strong near-camera framing, branching passages disappearing into blue-black shadows. Small restrained light spills and faint eerie glow keep the escape path legible. ABSOLUTELY NO TREASURE, coins, jewels, gold, treasure chests, loot piles, ornate gold architecture or bright gemstone gardens. Treasure belongs to a later level. Do not turn this into a bright crystal grotto or a grand open treasure hall. Tunnel geometry direction: the main run is a large curving circular bore, with a rideable rounded halfpipe floor continuing smoothly up BOTH walls into a fully enclosed curved ceiling. No flat-roof rectangular corridor. Its interior diameter is about twice the diameter of the pursuing boulder, leaving generous physical clearance through curved bends. Branches are real separate circular passages and the boulder is visibly following the runner's chosen tunnel, never clipping through the dividing rock. Maintain the dark, wet, sculpted natural-cave character and strong readable route.
